project.title: Mammalian community of "Filtration of airborne eDNA outperforms leaf swabs for terrestrial vertebrate detection in a temperate mixed forest with longer filtration times performing the best"
project.description: These sequence files include the 6 PCR replicates of mammalian dataset generated with 16Smam primers (Taylor, P. G. Reproducibility of ancient DNA sequences from extinct Pleistocene fauna. Mol Biol Evol 13 (1996)) from the Lille Vildmose nature area in Denmark. The study was conducted to evaluate the effect of filtration time on vertebrate community detections of airborne eDNA and compare the performance between active filtration of airborne eDNA and eDNA sampled with leaf swabs.
